Upstreman 3.2 Cu.Ft Mini Fridge with Freezer, Quiet Efficient Small Fridge

$139.98
A 3.2 cubic foot mini fridge hits the sweet spot for a dorm room — big enough for a week's worth of drinks, yogurt, leftovers, and frozen meals, but not so big that it dominates your space. The Upstreman runs quietly (important when it's six feet from your bed) and has an actual freezer compartment that can hold ice cream and frozen pizzas. The adjustable thermostat means you can dial it down when you're only storing drinks and save some power. It's a straightforward, no-nonsense mini fridge that does exactly what you need.
